messages:
dana: Quick proposal — pre-launch acceptance checklist for v2 route handoff + deprecation window. Key items I think are non-negotiable: migration guide, SDK shims, explicit opt-in redirect, parity tests for streaming/tool-calls, telemetry + cost metrics, rollback policy, legal sign-off. Posting full checklist for short comments.

omar: SGTM. From infra/runtime side add: route parity tests (streaming, function call ABI, structured outputs), KV-cache compatibility, quantization behavior validation, and perf regression < 5% p50 latency.

lina: Telemetry note: we need dedicated metric names for v2 routes (v2.request.latency, v2.tokens.out). Also require token-level cost breakdown exposed in console for first 90 days.

sue: From SE/solutions: customers are asking for a 6-month migration window and automatic redirects if they opt-in. Also sample transformation scripts to handle small schema diffs.

dana: I don't want auto-redirects on by default (dangerous). Proposal: opt-in auto-redirect header + canary redirect for top 50 customers for 30d to catch breakage. Public docs + migration guide must be published before auto-redirect opt-ins.

omar: Implementation detail suggestion: support legacy header for 12 months. Example shim:```
# client sets header to keep v1 behavior
Accept-Version: v1
X-Compat-Mode: keep-v1-cache-behavior
```
Runtime will route: if `Accept-Version: v1` -> route to v2 runtime with v1 compatibility layer for 12 months, log compatibility flag. After 12 months header still accepted but will return deprecation warning in response.

marvin: CS input: we need a migration playbook with runnable curl + SDK examples + a checklist for customers (tokens to regen, expected diffs, fallback steps). Can we get a canonical set of 10 prompts to test parity?

dana: Good call — launch gates I propose: docs published, migration guide + examples, SDK patches released (py/js/go), canary completes with <1% quality regression on canonical eval set, telemetry hooks live, deprecation comms drafted, legal sign-off. Only then GA.

legal-bot: Flag: private deployments and VPC customers may need a DPA addendum update and KMS key handling documented. Legal review required before public GA.

dana: Noted. Lina please track DPA/contract status in the launch checklist.

lina: Will do. Also verifying rate-limit semantics: v2 routes must preserve per-token billing and rate limit tokens equivalently to v1 for 3 months to avoid billing surprises.

omar: A couple of engineering Qs: are embeddings dimension and normalization stable across v1->v2? Rerank score scales? Need eval harness to assert no silent drift. I'll add an automated regression job:
```
# nightly eval job pseudo
python eval_harness.py --suite canonical-v1 --compare v1 v2 --threshold 0.01
```
If regression > threshold block rollout.

sue: Add structured output schema compatibility checks. Some customers rely on strict JSON path. Provide transformation shim examples (small JS snippets) in the guide.

dana: Ownership: I will own public comms & migration docs. Omar own runtime + tests. Lina own telemetry + compliance items. Marvin run customer outreach and compile the canonical prompt suite. Legal handle contract changes. Deploy-bot — schedule canary.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-04-15 03:00 UTC. Canary group routing + rollback endpoints ready. Will post canary live link once deployed.

dana: Timeline note: propose soft-deprecation announcement to beta customers 90 days before automatic opt-in window, public deprecation notice 60 days before GA for any customers without opt-in. Final removal only after 12 months of header acceptance + 30 days final notice.

marvin: I'll draft customer migration email + in-console banner copy. Also adding support playbook for priority customers.

dana: Quick checklist summary (short):
- Docs & migration guide published
- SDKs updated (py/js/go) + samples
- Canonical eval suite passing (<1% quality/regression)
- Telemetry & billing token breakdown live
- Legal sign-off for DPA/kms
- Canary completed and rollback tested
- Customer comms + CS playbook ready
- Deprecation timeline communicated (90/60/30 days as above)

omar: I'll start PRs for the compatibility layer and the CI eval job. CC: @lina for metrics hooks.

lina: Adding metric dashboards and cost breakdown widgets this week.

sue: Adding sample transform scripts and migration FAQ to the guide.

dana: If no objections I'll convert this thread into a checklist ticket and owner tags by EOD. :thumbsup:

omar: :thumbsup:

lina: :thumbsup:

marvin: Thanks — will sync with top 12 customers for migration windows.

legal-bot: Logged legal review request: ticket LEG-2026-78.

deploy-bot: Canary job created: job-8892.jnl (will post results).
